* GenericFlybackPWM 3.0 -- LTspice behavioral PWM building blocks.
* Original implementation. NOT an MP6005 silicon model.
* Voltages are referenced to COM. Frequencies Hz, slope V/s, times seconds.
* CORE: COMP CS EN VCC GATE RAMP COM. MODE=1 peak current, MODE=0 voltage.
.subckt GPWM_CORE COMP CS EN VCC GATE RAMP COM params: FSW=250e3 MODE=1 DMAX=0.7 VM=1 A_CS=1 SLOPE=0 CS_LIM=1 TBLANK=100e-9 TONMIN=100e-9 TPROP=20e-9 VG=10 RDRV=2 UVLO=4.5
Vclock clock COM PULSE(0 1 0 1e-9 1e-9 {min(20e-9,0.01/FSW)} {1/FSW})
Bage age COM V=(time*{FSW}-floor(time*{FSW}))/{FSW}
Bon active COM V=if((V(EN,COM)>0.5)&(V(VCC,COM)>{UVLO}),1,0)
Bramp RAMP COM V=if({MODE}>0.5,{A_CS}*V(CS,COM)+{SLOPE}*V(age,COM),{VM}*{FSW}*V(age,COM))
Breset reset COM V=if((V(active,COM)<0.5)|(V(age,COM)>={DMAX/FSW})|((V(age,COM)>={TBLANK})&(V(CS,COM)>={CS_LIM}))|((V(age,COM)>={max(TBLANK,TONMIN)})&(V(RAMP,COM)>=V(COMP,COM))),1,0)
Bset set COM V=if((V(clock,COM)>0.5)&(V(active,COM)>0.5)&(V(reset,COM)<0.5),1,0)
Alatch set reset COM COM COM COM q COM SRFLOP Vhigh=1 Vlow=0 Td={TPROP} Trise=5e-9 Tfall=5e-9
Bdrive drive COM V=if(V(active,COM)>0.5,{VG}*V(q,COM),0)
Rdriver drive GATE {RDRV}
Rgate GATE COM 1e9
.ends GPWM_CORE

* GCOMP: error EN COMP COM. Small signal transfer:
* TYPE=2: KP*(1+s/wz1)/(s*(1+s/wp1)).
* TYPE=3: the above times (1+s/wz2)/(1+s/wp2).
* Integral state freezes when saturated in the direction of the error.
.subckt GCOMP ERR EN COMP COM params: TYPE=2 KP=100 FZ1=100 FP1=30e3 FZ2=1e3 FP2=80e3 CMIN=0 CMAX=2
Bint integ COM V=idt(if(V(EN,COM)<0.5,0,if(((V(raw,COM)>={CMAX})&(V(ERR,COM)>0))|((V(raw,COM)<={CMIN})&(V(ERR,COM)<0)),0,{KP}*V(ERR,COM))),0,V(EN,COM)<0.5)
Blead lead COM V=V(integ,COM)+{KP/(2*pi*FZ1)}*V(ERR,COM)
Rlp1 lead lp1 1
Clp1 lp1 COM {1/(2*pi*FP1)}
Bbuffer stage2 COM V=V(lp1,COM)
Rlp2 stage2 lp2 1
Clp2 lp2 COM {1/(2*pi*FP2)}
Braw raw COM V=if({TYPE}>2.5,{FP2/FZ2}*V(lp1,COM)+(1-{FP2/FZ2})*V(lp2,COM),V(lp1,COM))
Blimit COMP COM V=if(V(EN,COM)>0.5,limit(V(raw,COM),{CMIN},{CMAX}),0)
.ends GCOMP

* GFLY_CTRL: FB CS EN VCC GATE COMP RAMP SS COM.
* FB is already isolated and scaled by the user's feedback network.
* VSET is in those same FB volts. SS ramps 0..1 and resets on disable/UVLO.
* Use CORE alone to connect an arbitrary external error amplifier to COMP.
.subckt GFLY_CTRL FB CS EN VCC GATE COMP RAMP SS COM params: FSW=250e3 MODE=1 DMAX=0.7 VM=1 A_CS=1 SLOPE=0 CS_LIM=1 TBLANK=100e-9 TONMIN=100e-9 TPROP=20e-9 VG=10 RDRV=2 UVLO=4.5 VSET=30 TSS=1e-3 TYPE=2 KP=100 FZ1=100 FP1=30e3 FZ2=1e3 FP2=80e3 CMAX=2

Bss SS COM V=limit(idt(if(V(active,COM)>0.5,1/{TSS},0),0,V(active,COM)<0.5),0,1)
Berror error COM V={VSET}*V(SS,COM)-V(FB,COM)
Xcomp error active COMP COM GCOMP TYPE={TYPE} KP={KP} FZ1={FZ1} FP1={FP1} FZ2={FZ2} FP2={FP2} CMAX={CMAX}
Xcore COMP CS active VCC GATE RAMP COM GPWM_CORE FSW={FSW} MODE={MODE} DMAX={DMAX} VM={VM} A_CS={A_CS} SLOPE={SLOPE} CS_LIM={CS_LIM} TBLANK={TBLANK} TONMIN={TONMIN} TPROP={TPROP} VG={VG} RDRV={RDRV} UVLO={UVLO}
.ends GFLY_CTRL

* Extended core with an external raw-CS limit and absolute COMP offset.
.subckt GPWM_CORE2 COMP CS EN VCC GATE RAMP ILIM COM params: FSW=250e3 MODE=1 DMAX=0.7 VM=1 A_CS=1 SLOPE=0 TBLANK=100e-9 TONMIN=100e-9 TPROP=20e-9 VG=10 RDRV=2 UVLO=4.5 COFF=0
Vclock clock COM PULSE(0 1 0 1e-9 1e-9 {min(20e-9,0.01/FSW)} {1/FSW})
Bage age COM V=(time*{FSW}-floor(time*{FSW}))/{FSW}
Bon active COM V=if((V(EN,COM)>0.5)&(V(VCC,COM)>{UVLO}),1,0)
Bramp RAMP COM V=if({MODE}>0.5,{A_CS}*V(CS,COM)+{SLOPE}*V(age,COM),{VM}*{FSW}*V(age,COM))
Breset reset COM V=if((V(active,COM)<0.5)|(V(age,COM)>={DMAX/FSW})|((V(age,COM)>={TBLANK})&(V(CS,COM)>=V(ILIM,COM)))|((V(age,COM)>={max(TBLANK,TONMIN)})&(V(RAMP,COM)>=max(0,V(COMP,COM)-{COFF}))),1,0)
Bset set COM V=if((V(clock,COM)>0.5)&(V(active,COM)>0.5)&(V(reset,COM)<0.5)&(V(COMP,COM)>{COFF}),1,0)
Alatch set reset COM COM COM COM q COM SRFLOP Vhigh=1 Vlow=0 Td={TPROP} Trise=5e-9 Tfall=5e-9
Bdrive drive COM V=if(V(active,COM)>0.5,{VG}*V(q,COM),0)
Rdriver drive GATE {RDRV}
Rgate GATE COM 1e9
.ends GPWM_CORE2

* MP6005-inspired supervisory state machine; no proprietary implementation.
* SCMODE=0 cycle limit only, 1 hiccup, 2 latch until disable/UVLO.
* OLP: after soft start, an OCP pulse refreshes a normalized hold timer.
.subckt GPROTECT CS GATE EN VCC RUN SS ILIM FAULT OLPSTATE COM params: FSW=250e3 VG=10 UVLO=4.5 TEN=0 TSS=1e-3 SSMODE=0 SSFRAC=0.05 CS_LIM=0.16 SCMODE=0 SCP=0.3 SCPBLANK=250e-9 OLPEN=0 TOLP=4.8e-3 THOLD=50e-6 TOFF=340e-3 TBLANK=250e-9
Benabled enabled COM V=if((V(EN,COM)>0.5)&(V(VCC,COM)>{UVLO}),1,0)
Bready ready COM V=if(V(enabled,COM)>0.5,if({TEN}<=0,1,limit(idt(1/{max(TEN,1e-9)},0,V(enabled,COM)<0.5),0,1)),0)
Bage age COM V=(time*{FSW}-floor(time*{FSW}))/{FSW}
Brun RUN COM V=if((V(ready,COM)>=0.999)&(V(enabled,COM)>0.5)&(V(FAULT,COM)<0.5),1,0)
Bss SS COM V=limit(idt(if(V(RUN,COM)>0.5,1/{TSS},0),0,V(RUN,COM)<0.5),0,1)
Blim ILIM COM V={CS_LIM}*if({SSMODE}==1,{SSFRAC}+(1-{SSFRAC})*V(SS,COM),1)
Bocp ocp COM V=if((V(RUN,COM)>0.5)&(V(GATE,COM)>{VG/2})&(V(age,COM)>={TBLANK})&(V(CS,COM)>=V(ILIM,COM)),1,0)
Bseen seen COM V=if(idt(V(ocp,COM),0,V(RUN,COM)<0.5)>1e-12,1,0)
Bhold hold COM V=idt(1/{THOLD},0,(V(ocp,COM)>0.5)|(V(RUN,COM)<0.5))
Bover over COM V=if((V(seen,COM)>0.5)&(V(hold,COM)<1)&(V(SS,COM)>0.999)&({OLPEN}>0.5),1,0)
Btimer OLPSTATE COM V=limit(idt(1/{TOLP},0,V(over,COM)<0.5),0,1.01)
Bscp scp COM V=if((V(RUN,COM)>0.5)&(V(GATE,COM)>{VG/2})&(V(age,COM)>={SCPBLANK})&(V(CS,COM)>={SCP}),1,0)
Btrip trip COM V=if(({SCMODE}>0.5)&((V(scp,COM)>0.5)|(V(OLPSTATE,COM)>=1)),1,0)
Boff offage COM V=limit(idt(1/{TOFF},0,V(FAULT,COM)<0.5),0,1.01)
Breset reset COM V=if((V(enabled,COM)<0.5)|(({SCMODE}<1.5)&(V(offage,COM)>=1)),1,0)
Bset set COM V=if((V(trip,COM)>0.5)&(V(reset,COM)<0.5),1,0)
Afault set reset COM COM COM COM FAULT COM SRFLOP Vhigh=1 Vlow=0 Td=5e-9 Trise=5e-9 Tfall=5e-9
.ends GPROTECT
